WITH overall_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_qty
    FROM Order_Items
    WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL
),
order_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as order_avg_qty
    FROM Order_Items
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT 
    os.order_id,
    os.order_avg_qty,
    os.order_avg_qty - os_total.avg_qty as difference
FROM order_stats os
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os_total
WHERE os_total.avg_qty IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    difference IS NULL,
    difference DESC
LIMIT 10
